name: pancake_inspect_messages
description: Inspect conversation messages, Chatbot 2.0 decisions, bot_audit_logs, tags, latest order push, and/or raw Pancake provider messages & attachment URLs (payment bills, Zalo QR codes, POS order cards, phone numbers). Read-only.

target.description: Any target reference: Pancake URL (https://pancake.vn/...?c_id=...), Pancake conversation ID (PAGEID_PSID, POSTID_COMMENTID, pzl_u_...), local UUID, message ID (m_...), or Admin Order ID

orderId.description: VietLicense Admin Order ID or local order push UUID

source.description: Where to read messages from: 'db' (Admin/Ops DB), 'provider' (direct Pancake API), or 'both' (default: 'both')

connectorKey.description: Optional explicit connector key when reading from provider

includeRawProviderPayload.description: Include raw Pancake message JSON objects for deep attachment/POS debugging (default: false)
